entry.name: IBM AI Engineering Professional Certificate
entry.note: A multi-course professional certificate, not a proctored exam; machine learning and deep learning with Python
entry.audience: Career changers and developers moving into machine learning engineering

covers: large language models and generative AI
reading.format: 13-course series delivered online with hands-on labs, projects, and practical evaluations.
reading.summary: This professional certificate teaches AI engineering skills including machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, and large language models. Learners build, train, and deploy models using Python and libraries such as PyTorch, Keras, TensorFlow, SciPy, and ScikitLearn. The program includes hands-on labs and projects to develop practical experience. Earning it demonstrates job-ready expertise for AI engineer roles.
reading.audience: Data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, and other technical specialists looking to get job-ready as an AI engineer.
reading.prerequisites: Intermediate level; recommended experience includes machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, ML algorithms, SciPy, ScikitLearn, Apache Spark, Keras, PyTorch, TensorFlow, and large language modeling.
